d: RJD Offer to Nishant Kumar :bihar ki siyasat men in dinon ek bar phir se nitish kumar ki gunj sunayi de rahi hai...pahle soniya gandhi ki kitab ko lekar nitish kumar par charcha huee...phir patna men pul ke namakran ko lekar nitish kumar surkhiyon men aa gae .. aur ab RJD ki or se nitish kumar ko mahagathbandhan men aane ka nyota die jane par siyasi ho-halla shuru ho gaya hai... daraasal, RJD sansad abhay kushvaha ne nitish kumar ko mahagathbandhan men aane ka nyota dete hue yahan tak kah diya hai ki lalu yadav aur tejasvi yadav ke netritv men nishant kumar ko mukhyamantri banaya ja sakta…
